title: Personal Sender Account Standing Goodwill on Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Errors
content:
Loyalty recognition terms: a fixed goodwill amount for long-standing customers at higher Personal Sender Account levels when a **Mobile Wallet** transfer was credited to the wrong wallet.

**Standing goodwill.** The standing goodwill on a wrong-wallet funding follows the customer's Personal Sender Account, with whole calendar months counted from its opened date to today:

| Personal Sender Account level | Open at least 36 whole calendar months | Standing goodwill (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Enhanced or higher (level number 4 or more) | yes | 5.00 |
| Paloma Verified Plus (level number 3) | yes | 2.50 |
| Paloma Enhanced or higher, or Paloma Verified Plus | no | nothing |
| any other level | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases (today 2026-04-20)
- Paloma Enhanced, opened 2023-04-20: 36 whole months, 5.00.
- Paloma Enhanced, opened 2023-04-21: 35 whole months, nothing.
- Paloma Verified Plus, opened 2020-01-05: 75 whole months, 2.50.
- Paloma Verified, opened 2018-06-01: nothing.
